title: The Donkey and the Cart
summary: A merchant piled his cart so high with melons that the donkey could not take a single step....
full_text:
A merchant piled his cart so high with melons that the donkey could not take a single step.

Nasruddin took off ten melons and gave them to village children: "Now the cart rolls, the children smile, and the donkey walks in peace. Moderation is the grease that oils the axles of the world!"
moral: Do not overload the willing servant until the wheels break.
